primary_success_philosophy: Targeted behavioral and semantic correctness over loss minimization

unnecessary_tool_call_rate.metric_name: Unnecessary Tool Call Rate on Direct Questions (FPR)
unnecessary_tool_call_rate.rationale: Experiment D called tools on 18/36 direct tasks. Experiment E must eliminate false positives on conceptual knowledge.

web_selection_recall.rationale: Must not sacrifice web retrieval capability while calibrating direct decisions.

python_selection_recall.rationale: Preserve high-precision mathematical and programmatic execution.

evidence_extraction_accuracy.metric_name: Factual Evidence Extraction Accuracy on Executed Web Calls
evidence_extraction_accuracy.denominator_description: All tasks where web search executed cleanly with factual target
evidence_extraction_accuracy.rationale: Currently 80 of 106 executed calls fail to extract correct facts. Structured evidence schema must more than double this.

evidence_grounded_answer_correctness.metric_name: Evidence-Grounded Semantic Correctness on Web Tasks
evidence_grounded_answer_correctness.rationale: Final answers must be strictly grounded in retrieved evidence rather than parametric hallucinations.

multistep_web_python_success.metric_name: Multi-Step Web -> Python Chaining Success Rate
multistep_web_python_success.denominator_description: 15 multi-step benchmark tasks requiring empirical lookup then math
multistep_web_python_success.rationale: Experiment D had 0/15 success due to lack of chaining. Multi-turn harness support must unlock this pathway.

end_to_end_semantic_success.rationale: Must achieve statistically significant improvement over Experiment D (p < 0.01 via McNemar test).

mcnemar_statistical_significance.metric_name: Statistical Significance of Improvement vs Experiment D
mcnemar_statistical_significance.test_type: McNemar two-tailed test with Edwards continuity correction
mcnemar_statistical_significance.rationale: Prove conclusively that gains are not random variance.
